newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Jan-April forestry exports rise four pct. [CORRECTED 18:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Chile Jan-April forestry exports rise four pct. [CORRECTED 18:00 GMT]

text.p: Chilean forestry exports totalled $616 million (corrects from $162 million) in the first four months of the year, up four percent on the same period last year, said state forestry agency CONAF.
"Despite this rise, the cumulative result is poor. We expect similar figures this year to 1996 which was one of the worst in recent time," said CONAF in a statement.
The figures showed that exports in the 12 months to April were 18 percent lower than in the year ending in April 1996.
"Despite these negative indicators, the improvement seen in wood pulp prices should lead to a rise in exports in coming months," it said.
Exports of pulp, Chile's main forestry product, rose three percent in the first four months of the year compared with the same period in 1996.
Copec's forestry division, Celulosa Arauco y Constitucion, was the top exporter in the January-April period with shipments worth $124 million.
